info.title: Salli API
info.description: Privacy-first personal finance & tax for Sri Lanka

get.description:
Return the authenticated user's identity.
The user_id comes from the verified JWT sub claim (or the raw token in dev mode).
Clients use this to confirm their token is valid and get their canonical ID.
Account detail, current balance, and running-balance transaction history.

post.description:
AI-parse a free-text / dictated note into a DRAFT entry (never posted).

The LLM extracts the stated amount and maps the note to existing account ids;
the client pre-fills the New Entry form for the user to review and post via
the deterministic, balance-checked POST /entries/. Counts against the same
monthly AI-usage quota as /agent/chat — it's an AI feature like any other.

get.description: Where this entry came from: a bank-statement transaction, or an attached receipt.

post.description:
Upload a file to be attached to a chat message.
Returns a file_ref ID to pass in the subsequent /agent/chat request.
Supported: PDF, TXT, CSV, PNG, JPG, XLSX.

Transcribe a recorded voice message to text (mobile Voice Mode).

Turn-based, not streaming: the client records a whole push-to-talk
utterance, uploads it here once released, and sends the returned text
through the normal /agent/chat flow like any typed message.

Resume an interrupted agent.
- workflow="chat": resumes a write-tool approval gate (decision: "approved"|"denied")
- workflow="return": resumes the return-preparation workflow (decision: "approve"|"reject")

get.description: Return the message history for a conversation thread.
Return the user's conversation sessions (for this persona) sorted by most recent activity.
Every agent-initiated write decision (approved or denied).
List agent documents. Optionally filter by namespace, tags, or full-text search.

get.description: Retrieve a single document by ID.
Check whether the user has completed onboarding.

post.description:
Save profile as agent memories and create a starter chart of accounts.
Idempotent — safe to call again if the user re-runs onboarding.

get.description: The structured fact-find profile — identity, risk profile, life stage.

post.description: Post real opening-balance journal entries so net worth is non-zero immediately.
Post one representative monthly entry per declared income source.
Score the risk-tolerance questionnaire and persist score/category/life-stage.
Create one or more goals — repeatable, unlike the legacy single-goal flow.

get.description: Everything Salli has stored about this user, as one JSON document.

delete.description:
Permanently delete every row belonging to this user. Irreversible.
Requires confirm_email to match the authenticated account's email —
a deliberate friction point against an accidental or spoofed call.

post.description:
Parse a bank statement file. Returns the statement_id and extracted transactions.
Transactions have LLM-assigned accounts and dedup status; review before posting.
Counts one statement upload against the user's monthly quota.

get.description: Return unposted transactions for a statement.

post.description: Post approved transactions as journal entries.
Seed the IRD filing deadlines for the given year of assessment.

Detect current Budget/Subscription/Insurance alert conditions and
upsert them as reminders. Idempotent — safe to call repeatedly.

get.description: Current plan, status, and per-metric usage (used/limit/remaining/resets_at).
Plan catalog for the upgrade/pricing UI.

post.description: Return the data the client passes to Paddle.js to open checkout.
Return a Paddle customer-portal URL for managing or cancelling the subscription.
Receive Paddle subscription events (no auth; verified by HMAC signature).

get.description: Latest FI score, computing one on first access.

post.description: Recompute the FI score from the current ledger and store a snapshot.

get.description: Return the user's active FIRE strategy, or 404 if none exists yet.
List all strategy versions (summary only).

post.description:
Trigger AI FIRE strategy generation. Returns an SSE stream.

Stream events:
  {"type": "status",  "message": "..."} — progress updates
  {"type": "done",    "strategy": {...}} — final result
  {"type": "error",   "message": "..."}  — failure

Counts against the same monthly AI-usage quota as /agent/chat — checked
before the stream opens, same as chat, rather than mid-stream.

get.description: 15-year portfolio projections across conservative/base/growth scenarios.
Income-by-source and expense-by-category breakdown from the trailing 12 months.

post.description:
Cost a prospective purchase in months of freedom, comparing cash against
instalments.

Deliberately NOT metered: it is pure deterministic engine math with no LLM
call, and it is the loop the product exists for — throttling it would teach
users not to ask.
Run the Wealth Advisor now (counts against the advisor_runs quota).

Run the monthly briefing workflow up to the human review gate. Returns the
draft briefing for approval, or a gather-step error (e.g. quota exceeded).
Resume the briefing workflow after human review and persist if approved.
Trigger the daily advisor for all due paid users. Auth: X-Cron-Secret header.

get.description: Category limits vs. actual ledger spend for the budget's period.

post.description:
File a bug report. Always persisted locally; mirrored to the issue tracker on
a best-effort basis, so a tracker outage still returns 201.

get.description: Avalanche/snowball payoff plan — months to payoff, total interest, schedule.
Allocation by asset class, total gain/ROI, and (if target given) rebalancing alerts.
Missed-charge/price-change reports for every active subscription.
Missed-charge/price-change report for a single subscription.

Coverage-gap report: target vs. actual coverage per type, missing types,
and policies expiring within the next 30 days.
Download a report as CSV. report_type: balance-sheet | net-worth | goal-progress.

AccountHint.title: AccountHint
AccountHint.description:
A suggested NEW account (name + type) when the parser couldn't match an
existing one but can infer what kind of account the transaction implies.

PurchaseRequest.title: PurchaseRequest
PurchaseRequest.description:
Money arrives as a STRING and is parsed to Decimal, never float — a float in
the money path is a bug (CLAUDE.md). `annual_interest_rate` is a fraction
(0.18 = 18%), bounded so a caller passing 18 is rejected rather than
silently costing the plan ~100x too dearly.
